lines.text: The LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre, and Abraham saw three men standing nearby.
Abraham offered water and bread, then told Sarah to prepare three seahs of fine flour.
Abraham chose a tender and choice goat, and he set it before the men with curds and milk.
The men asked where Sarah was, and the LORD said she would have a son at this time next year.
Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, "I was not listening."
